description: Two named phases of the Christina Lake SAGD project are grouped as distinct expansion components. Phases 1E, 1F and 1G would increase capacity from 98,800 to 218,800 barrels per day and have source-labelled EIA completion in 2011. Phase H and the eastern expansion would increase overall capacity to 310,000 barrels per day and have completion labelled 2015. Both are near Conklin. The phases are not identical records and their capacities must not be added together. Component identities remain distinct; this grouping does not imply identical files, seamless coverage or complete provider coverage. Geographic coverage is Alberta.
